Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Mahesh Varghese. I am a 75-year-old farmer living in Kochi. Chandran Enterprises gave me a cheque for Rs 24,80,000 to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 75072 33130 or email mahesh.varghese54@example.com.
